policy.modifiedAtMeaning: Exact READY time of the production content release introducing the current complete article content.
policy.articleComparison: Exact complete article includes related-link text. Head JSON-LD, global navigation and footer outside article are not part of this comparison.
policy.futureRevision: Remove or replace modifiedAt whenever article content changes; do not carry a timestamp across new content.
